key_entities: pytest -m not integration and not external
propositions: The import-linter job in _optionality.yml consumes one concurrent slot and runs byte-identical setup to _build-and-test.yml but only on a single matrix cell (ubuntu/3.12), while the same tests already run in all four matrix cells (3.11/3.12/3.13 + macOS) providing strictly more coverage.

Deleting the import-linter job opens a gap where tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py and tests/unit/test_optional.py are no longer explicitly guarded by CI, risking a future contributor adding markers or filters that silently remove them from the default test selection.

A durable checked-in test asserting the two optionality files collect exactly 9 items under default marker selection (-m 'not integration and not external') will catch any future marker addition, file move, or filter that excludes them.
The import-linter job does not provide an irreproducible-import guard because its covered tests use subprocess spawning and ast.parse, not a shared sys.modules state, so the deletion is safe.
